page_title: Endgame Encore: Your Celestial Box Office Bonanza
date_caption: Created September 28, 2026 for the 40th week of 2026.

news.title: Box Office: ‘Avengers: Endgame Encore’ Returns to No. 1 With $26 Million, ‘Primetime’ Scores Impressive $19 Million Debut - Variety

weekly_forecast: This week, prepare for the universe to re-release all your unfinished business, just like 'Avengers: Endgame Encore' dominating the box office. Expect old flames to reappear, forgotten tasks to demand attention, and that one outfit you regret buying to suddenly seem like a good idea again. Don't be surprised if your barista tries to sell you an 'enhanced experience' coffee for an extra dollar. Your best bet? Lean into the nostalgia, but maybe don't buy the same movie ticket twice.
